calls.statement:
WITH as_of AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS e),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key CROSS JOIN as_of
  WHERE f.sale_date > e - 364 AND f.sale_date <= e)
SELECT cur.tier, COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) AS members
FROM active a CROSS JOIN as_of JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id=a.member_id AND e BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH as_of AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS e),
base AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, s.store_id, p.category, f.sale_date, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.channel_code
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key CROSS JOIN as_of
  WHERE f.sale_date > e - 364 AND f.sale_date <= e),
tot AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) n FROM base),
clean AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) n FROM base WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test'),
notweb AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) n FROM base WHERE store_id<>999),
joined_after AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.member_id) n FROM base b JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id=b.member_id AND m.is_current WHERE m.join_date > DATE '2025-12-21')
SELECT (SELECT n FROM tot) tot, (SELECT n FROM clean) clean_no999_noZZ, (SELECT n FROM notweb) no999, (SELECT n FROM joined_after) joined_after,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id, valid_from, COUNT(*) c FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL HAVING c>1)) dup_versions,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member a JOIN dim_member b ON a.member_id=b.member_id AND a.member_key<b.member_key AND a.valid_from<=b.valid_to AND b.valid_from<=a.valid_to) overlaps,
 (SELECT MAX(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) maxdate
